desc: Analyze the problem and constraints (N<=30, M<=100, K<=100)
Identify that binary search on the answer D is a viable approach
Formulate the check(D) function: Can we choose K edges such that every path from 1 to N has at least D weight-1 edges?
Implement binary search on the answer D from 0 to N
Implement the check(D) function using DP: dp[v][j] = min weight-1 edges on path to v with j edges
Handle the global constraint of exactly K edges in the check function
